key_highlights: ASX edges higher on energy sector strength as oil rises amid tanker tensions, but iron ore weakness pressures BHP and miners
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; RBA signals it will not intervene to support property market
Mortgage cost pressure drives Australians into second jobs, signalling household stress and consumer spending risk
EV sales outpace petrol cars for first time in Australia; BYD declares EV tipping point reached
Bathla construction collapse highlights systemic risk in Australian construction sector
Ratings agencies flag Victoria's soaring debt as a sovereign credit concern
Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar) show relative strength
US Fed rate hike debate and rising bond yields create headwinds for global risk assets

sectors.trend: Iron ore price collapse pressures BHP and peers; small-cap gold and critical minerals (vanadium, rare earths) outperform on diversification and strategic demand
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin compression; rotate into gold (AUR.AX, NGN.AX) and critical minerals (VNR.AX, PCH.AX, BRS.AX, SOL.AX, PMV.AX)

sectors.trend: Oil price rise on tanker tensions lifts Woodside, Santos, and oil services; EV transition accelerates but doesn't yet offset oil demand
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, STO.AX, and oil services names benefit short-term; long-term EV adoption (BYD, #37) is a structural headwind for fossil fuel revenue

sectors.trend: Accelerating house price falls and household stress (second jobs, #2) raise NPL concerns; RBA unlikely to cut aggressively to save property (#29)
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face credit cost pressure; super access debate (#15) could alter fund flows; Victoria debt warning (#67) pressures state-linked lending

sectors.trend: Household affordability squeeze (mortgages, kids' sport costs, #12) suppresses discretionary spending; EV adoption shifts auto spending
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX, LSG.AX face margin pressure; EV-related names and BYD supply chain benefit

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse (#5, #66) signals systemic fragility; free tradie qualifications (#34) and skilled migration push (#59) are policy responses
sectors.implications: CPB.AX, WBC.AX (construction lending) face elevated counterparty risk; monitor for further contractor defaults

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control (#10); AI displaces Auslan interpreters (#27); global AI capex cycle continues (AVGO, CRWD, NVDA)
sectors.implications: SWS.AX governance shift; ASX-listed tech remains thin; global AI names drive sentiment spillover

key_themes: Iron ore price collapse vs. energy strength: commodity rotation within materials
Housing downturn accelerates; RBA non-intervention stance confirmed
Household affordability crisis: second jobs, rising costs, consumer stress
EV tipping point in Australia: structural shift in transport and energy demand
Construction sector fragility: Bathla as canary in the coal mine
US Fed rate hike risk and rising bond yields as global headwind
Small-cap and critical minerals outperformance vs. large-cap miner weakness
Victoria sovereign debt warning and state fiscal sustainability

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse and BHP earnings downgrade
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold and critical minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating house price falls and rising NPLs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs (VGP.AX, ICPS.AX) and bank credit-sensitive names; monitor RBA commentary
Screen construction and infrastructure names for liquidity and counterparty risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US Fed rate hike and rising global bond yields
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD/USD; favour short-duration and dividend-paying ASX names
Monitor state bond spreads; avoid overexposure to Victorian REITs and infrastructure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino cyclone risk to energy and insurance
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review insurance (WBC.AX, CGU.AX) and energy infrastructure exposure ahead of cyclone season

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy and oil services on tanker-driven oil price support
opportunities.rationale: Oil rises on geopolitical tanker tensions; WDS.AX and STO.AX benefit from higher realised prices

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from large-cap iron ore miners into gold and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore crumbles while small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Aurum) show relative strength on strategic demand
EV sales surpass petrol cars; BYD confirms tipping point; auto and battery supply chain names gain structural tailwind

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to iron ore majors and housing-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore collapse and accelerating house price falls with RBA non-intervention create dual headwinds

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight banks on rising NPL risk from household stress
defensive_moves.rationale: Second-job surge and mortgage pressure signal deteriorating credit quality; RBA unlikely to ease aggressively

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and reduce global equity beta
defensive_moves.rationale: US Fed rate hike risk and rising bond yields pressure AUD and global risk assets

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower. Energy strength offsets miner weakness, but housing stress, RBA non-intervention, and US rate hike risk cap upside. Watch iron ore price floor and RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift toward critical minerals, EV supply chain, and energy transition. Iron ore-dependent revenue model under pressure. Housing correction may extend 6-12 months. Consumer spending remains subdued. Diversification away from commodity concentration is key.
